name: lead-magnets
description: Pick a lead magnet for what you sell and decide whether to gate it; draft it from your own material with no invented figures; check an opt-in page, opt-in form, thank-you page and confirmation email against US, EU and UK email consent and sender rules; plan what each sign-up may receive given the consent it gave; and compare sign-up and sales-call rates by magnet, saying when the numbers are too small to judge. Checks, not legal advice.
